title: Upgrade sha2 0.10 -> 0.11 and hkdf 0.12 -> 0.13 (RustCrypto digest 0.11)
description:
Coupled: both ride the digest 0.11 trait transition, so they move together or not at all.

Highest-care item of the group. hkdf is the core of persona-core/src/pseudonym.rs, which the review singled out as the one piece of crypto that is correct and verified against externally computed pyca vectors (persona-5s4b.69). Those vectors are the oracle. After upgrading, the existing tests must still pass unchanged - if they need editing to pass, stop: that means the derivation changed and every already-issued pseudonym would break.
close_reason: sha2 0.11.0 + hkdf 0.13.0 upgraded. No source changes needed. All three pyca-derived known_vector tests pass unchanged, so the derivation is byte-identical. Tests 37/37.
